name: Paper & Ink
tagline: Warm cream pages, charcoal serif type and a single crimson accent, with drop caps, pull quotes, running heads and fine ornamented rules. Adapted from the Paper & Ink preset in frontend-slides.

palette.description: warm cream paper, charcoal ink for text and rules, crimson as the single accent for drop caps, ornaments, numerals and the one highlighted figure; warm greys for captions and hairlines

typography.style: high-contrast Garamond display at 500/600 with italic for emphasis and titles of works, paired with a sturdy text serif for body copy and letter-spaced uppercase running heads; old-style figures in text, lining figures in numbers

best_for: Publishing, literary and editorial presentations, humanities lectures, foundations, arts organisations and annual letters — talks where words carry the weight. Strong for essays with drop caps, pull quotes, contents pages, schedules and a few well-set numbers.
avoid_for: Fast product launches, dense dashboards, technical deep-dives and high-energy sales decks. The quiet serif look reads as slow and reflective by design.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
